children: maintains a small security force, The Koorivar Fusiliers, whose job is primarily to guard Alliance facilities against sabotage and industrial espionage. The Koorivar Fusiliers have a command structure similar to the Grand Army's, though not quite as extensive. Much of the Fusiliers' armed might relies on artillery emplacements, which are always crewed by two fusilier engineers and a crew leader.
The Fusilier's smallest group is the Squad, led by a Sergeant.
A Platoon consists of 3 Squads, led by a Lieutenant.
A Company consists of 3 Platoons, led by a Captain.
A Battalion consists of 3 Companies, led by a Colonel.
A Regiment consists of 3 Battalions, led by a General.
